criteria.name: Data Understanding & Quality Checks
criteria.guidance: Inspect patient attributes, status and lookup tables; verify identifiers, join keys, target mapping, missingness, duplicates and data quality.

criteria.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
criteria.guidance: Analyze target balance and clinical-feature distributions using appropriate statistics/plots, avoiding unsupported clinical interpretations.

criteria.name: Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
criteria.guidance: Handle missing values, types, outliers and categorical features transparently; exclude IDs and prevent leakage.

criteria.name: Linear Model Building
criteria.guidance: Build a reproducible baseline classifier with appropriate stratified splitting and preprocessing fitted on training data.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Report confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1 and ROC-AUC where valid; discuss false negatives, limitations and educational use.
